note: Commerce Stock is the stock framework for Drupal Commerce. It defines pluggable stock services (tagged commerce_stock.stock_service, resolved by commerce_stock.service_manager / StockServiceManager) and order->stock event handling (stock_events + commerce_stock_event_type plugin types), and registers a StockAvailabilityChecker. Built-in service always_in_stock; the commerce_stock_local submodule adds local_stock. Which service applies is chosen on the form at /admin/commerce/config/stock/settings (route commerce_stock.stock_config) and stored in commerce_stock.service_manager config: default_service_id, per-bundle <entity_type>_<bundle>_service_id (e.g. commerce_product_variation_default_service_id), and stock_events_plugin_id (core_stock_events / disabled_stock_events). All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real local config, verified by pure config reads - no external service or product data needed. Cleanup restores baseline explicitly (clears the keys / core_stock_events).

evals.prompt: In Drupal Commerce Stock, what are the built-in stock 'services', and which one do I need for real inventory tracking (actual stock quantities and locations)?
evals.expected_output: The core module ships only the Always-in-stock service (always_in_stock), which reports everything as available. For real inventory you enable the Commerce Stock Local Storage submodule, which adds the database-backed local_stock service with stock levels, locations and transactions.

evals.prompt: How do I choose which stock service Commerce Stock uses for a given product variation type, and where is that stored?
evals.expected_output: On the form at /admin/commerce/config/stock/settings (route commerce_stock.stock_config) you set a default service and a per-entity-type/bundle override. It is stored in commerce_stock.service_manager config: default_service_id plus per-bundle keys like commerce_product_variation_default_service_id (value use_default = fall back to default).

evals.prompt: Which Drupal Commerce Stock service and method would I use in code to read a product variation's available stock level, and what method records receiving new stock?
evals.expected_output: Use the commerce_stock.service_manager service (StockServiceManager): getStockLevel($entity) reads the available level, and receiveStock(...) (or the low-level createTransaction(...) with a STOCK_IN type) records incoming stock. It also has sellStock/moveStock/returnStock.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, which stock service is configured as the default in Commerce Stock? Inspect the live configuration and give the service id.
evals.expected_output: The default is local_stock: commerce_stock.service_manager has default_service_id set to local_stock.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the default product variation type has been assigned a specific Commerce Stock service (an override rather than 'use default'). Inspect the live configuration and state which stock service is set for the default product variation type.
evals.expected_output: It is local_stock: commerce_stock.service_manager has commerce_product_variation_default_service_id set to local_stock (the per-bundle override for the default product variation type).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Commerce Stock so that the default stock service is the local (database-backed) stock service, so products are tracked with real inventory by default. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: commerce_stock.service_manager default_service_id is set to local_stock (e.g. choose 'Local stock' as the Default service on /admin/commerce/config/stock/settings, or set the config key and save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, turn OFF Commerce Stock's automatic order-driven stock updates (do not let placing/cancelling orders change stock levels) by selecting the stock events plugin that disables them. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: commerce_stock.service_manager stock_events_plugin_id is set to disabled_stock_events (the DisabledStockEvents plugin), replacing the default core_stock_events.
